# NTT (News The Truth) Full Documentation

> Independent, State-of-the-Art Investigative Journalism Platform covering India, World, Politics, West Bengal, and breaking news.

## Comprehensive Content Sections & Endpoints

### News Feeds & Sections
- **Main Homepage**: https://newsthetruth.com/
- **India News**: https://newsthetruth.com/category/india (National news, governance, economics, internal security)
- **World News**: https://newsthetruth.com/category/world (Geopolitical affairs, global conflicts, diplomacy)
- **Politics**: https://newsthetruth.com/category/politics (Elections, policy debates, legislative tracking)
- **West Bengal**: https://newsthetruth.com/category/bengal (Regional reporting, Kolkata desk, investigative local news)
- **Archive Directory**: https://newsthetruth.com/archive (Searchable database of historical reports)
- **Journalist Desk**: https://newsthetruth.com/reporter (Verified profiles of newsroom investigative reporters)

### Machine-Readable Indexes & Sitemaps
- **News Sitemap**: https://newsthetruth.com/sitemap-news.xml (Google News XML format, updated dynamically)
- **Standard Sitemap**: https://newsthetruth.com/sitemap.xml (Comprehensive URL directory)
- **WebMCP Manifest**: https://newsthetruth.com/.well-known/mcp.json (Structured Model Context Protocol tool registry)

### AI Agent Capabilities & WebMCP Tools
NTT supports both Declarative (`data-mcp-tool`) and Imperative (`document.modelContext.registerTool`) browser agent capabilities:
1. `search_articles(query)`: Search investigative news articles by keyword.
2. `get_latest_news(limit)`: Retrieve real-time breaking news.
3. `get_categories()`: Enumerate news sections.
4. `subscribeNewsletter(email)`: Join the weekly investigative briefing.
